Phase 0 - Origin

Phase 00

The Origin

A simple rotation, an infinite vision

It began with one question: what if a wheelchair could be more than metal and wheels? What if every rotation could become intelligence that protects and empowers its user?

From that single spark, the WheelSense team formed around one conviction: assistive technology deserves the same ambition and engineering depth as any frontier innovation.

Phase 01 - Digitization

YES Wheelchair

Physical to Digital

YES Wheelchair installs sensor modules on both left and right wheels to capture speed, acceleration, distance, and fall-detection status in real time.

This turns daily motion into actionable telemetry for users, caregivers, and researchers.

Core

IoT Sensors

Feature

Speed, Acceleration, Distance, Fall Detection

Phase 02 - Interaction

ALL Wheelchair

Digital to Interaction

ALL Wheelchair introduces joystick-style control behavior to the wheelchair interaction model, allowing users to aim and control exercise games directly from movement input.

Rehabilitation becomes an engaging exergaming experience instead of repetitive training.

Core

Motion Tracking

Feature

Joystick-style Aim and Exergaming

Phase 03 - Expansion

smartVibe

Room to World

smartVibe extends the system into outdoor environments with connected telemetry, showing live map routes, coordinates, speed, and pacing analytics.

Real-world marathon tracking becomes visible end-to-end across the full race path.

Core

GPS and 4G LTE

Feature

Outdoor Route Tracking and Telemetry

Phase 04 - Intelligence

WheelSense

Vehicle to Companion

WheelSense combines AI with computer vision and indoor localization to understand context and guide wheelchair users inside complex indoor spaces.

It acts as an intelligent wheelchair companion connected to smart-home systems and proactive assistance.

Core

AI and Computer Vision

Feature

Indoor Localization and AI Assistance

Phase 05 - Integration

EASE AI

Vehicle to Caregiver

EASE AI transforms the wheelchair from a smart vehicle into a proactive health assistant. By integrating wearable sensors, indoor localization, and smart home automation, it creates a continuous monitoring ecosystem.

It bridges the gap between patient and caregiver, orchestrating the environment for preventive health and emergency response.

Core

HealthTech & AI Ecosystem

Feature

Continuous Monitoring & Smart Home Orchestration
